family_reports.body: This system has caused my family and I extreme stress, countless sleepless nights, missed work due to repeated court appearances that are often postponed, and an overwhelming number of appointments, while requiring unnecessary parenting classes despite my successful experience raising children. I feel I have been expected to follow policies that do not meet this child’s individual needs and, in my experience, have set him up for failure rather than success.

Family court has taken a child from her mother and has taken all rights from the mother so she cannot raise her own child; done by force, without compliance, without reason. Family court is the opposite of what is good. It’s harmful, callous, malicious, unlawful, and evil. We the people must protect our children from family court.
I almost died that day my children were "legally" kidnapped. It will take a lifetime to recover from this.
This system has destroyed my family to the point I don’t think the damage could ever be undone.

public_comments.comment_text: I obtained custody of the child through kinship care and now have permanent custody. He has been displaying increasingly unruly behavior. Rhonda has instructed me to allow him to remain out running the streets until 11:00 p.m. and not report him missing until 1:00 a.m. I have serious concerns about this approach given his history. He has known violent behavior, a history of drug use, an assault on a police officer charge, and has tested positive for drugs while on probation. Despite these incidents, I have not seen any meaningful action taken to address these ongoing safety concerns.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Rhonda ordered that I should have zero medical rights to my daughter because I didn’t give her medication. This decision is a personal choice in which all parents have the right to choose for their child. However Rhonda takes these personal rights away from the parent and demands her own authority. Her decision has caused my child to experience even greater harm from the medical field. One in which her life is forever changed.
